title: Number of Matching Subsequences
summary: Given a string and an array of strings, count how many of the array's strings can be formed by deleting some characters from the given string without changing the order of the remaining characters.
statement: Given a string and an array of strings, count how many of the array's strings can be formed by deleting some characters from the given string without changing the order of the remaining characters.
constraints: 1 <= len(s) <= 50,000; words are nonempty lowercase strings.
Count words that are subsequences of s, including duplicate word entries separately.
hints: Each waiting word needs only its next unmatched character.
Bucket word iterators by their next required character and advance one bucket per source character.
Remove the current bucket, advance each iterator, count completions, and rebucket the rest.
Each word character advances once, avoiding a full scan of s for every word.
editorial: Each word character advances once, avoiding a full scan of s for every word.
